cohort: 5,201 patients with live, term, singleton, vertex fetuses delivered by residents at Mount Sinai Hospital between July 2011 and June 2015
finding: Resident supervision by senior obstetricians was associated with an increased rate of forceps deliveries and a decreased rate of cesarean deliveries, with no significant differences in adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: The increase in forceps deliveries and decrease in cesarean deliveries were only observed during daytime hours when senior obstetricians were present.
